caption: For natural n>=1, the condition reduces to f(n)=-n*(n-8)*(n+2)>=0, hence 1<=n<=8 and there are 8 values; n>8 fails. At n=8, f_8(x)=2*x^3-30*x^2+96*x+128=2*(x-8)^2*(x+1)>=0 for x>=0, touching zero at x=8. This figure shows the n sets only, not a representative cubic graph.

sourceConditions.condition: The source asks for natural n and requires f(x)>=0 for all x>=0; f' (x)=6*(x-2)*(x-n).
For n>2, the local minimum occurs at x=n and f(n)=-n*(n-8)*(n+2); for natural n, this is nonnegative exactly through n=8. The separate n=1,2 cases are also valid.
n=8 is inclusive and f_8(x)=2*(x-8)^2*(x+1) touches zero at x=8; every natural n>8 fails.

newVisualInformation: The exact natural-number set [1,8] is shown as eight integer marks, followed by the open ray n>8. No half-line cubic graph is substituted for the source family or drawn as if its domain were all real x.
